brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Recycled 600D poly ripstop with TPU coating'. This is only fully correct for 3 of the 8 products. Alpha Handlebar Bag, Pannier Backpack Convertible 2.1 PLUS, and Pannier Backpack Convertible 2.0 LITE are specced VERBATIM by the maker as 'Recycled 600D Poly (Diamond) Ripstop fabric with TPU waterproof coating', and Alpha's own photo (assets/products/two-wheel-gear/alpha-alpha-handlebar-bag-6l-1.jpg) shows a visible diagonal diamond-ripstop grid confirming it. The other 5 products - Dayliner, Mamquam Frame Bag, Commute Top Tube Bag, Commute Seat Pack, and Inverter Pannier Backpack - are specced by the maker as plain 'TPU Waterproof Backed 600D Polyester' (Inverter's own page drops even the 'Backed' and just says 'Recycled 600D Polyester fabric with TPU waterproof coating'). None of those 5 pages use the word 'ripstop'. The photos back this up: Dayliner, Mamquam, and both Commute bags all show a smooth heathered/melange weave with no diamond grid, visibly different from Alpha's texture. Recommend reserving a diamond-ripstop texture for Alpha (and the two Pannier Backpack Convertibles, per their own copy) and rendering the other 5 with a plain smooth 600D poly finish.
brand_notes.method: Dimensions and material copy cross-checked against twowheelgear.com product pages via WebFetch (all 8 pages rendered cleanly, no client-side tab issue). Photos: all 11 local files in assets/products/two-wheel-gear/ were opened and reviewed; a curl attempt to fetch the one CDN image for Pannier Backpack Convertible 2.1 PLUS (no local file exists) returned an HTML redirect page, not image bytes, so that product has no photographic evidence at all - flagged on its record.

products.name: Commute Top Tube Bag
products.dims_raw: 9" Wide x 9.5" High x 2" Deep; 1 Liter
products.dims_note: Width (9in fore-aft along the top tube) and depth (2in) are fixed and used directly. The published 9.5in 'High' figure is a flat-panel trap - it is the panel laid flat including the wrap-around velcro strap wings, which would box out to 2.8L against a stated 1L, so it is NOT used. A previous pass back-computed height from volume (1000cm3 / (22.9 x 5.1) = 8.6cm); the spec explicitly forbids that method, so this record instead estimates height visually from photo 1 (closed, on-bike side view): the mounted body reads roughly half as tall as it is long, giving ~11cm. This is a genuine estimate, not a measurement - verified is false and confidence is low.
